subject: QuoteCore+ is officially live - and here's your welcome offer
heading: QuoteCore+ is officially live!
intro: You asked us to let you know when QuoteCore+ was live - and it officially is!
You were one of the people who signed up early to see what we were building, so I wanted to make sure you got a little something for being here from the start.
body: Use code WELCOME70 before 31 October 2026 to get 70% off your QuoteCore+ subscription for your first month.
bodyHtmlExtra: Have a play with it, create a real quote and see how it fits into the way you work. I'd genuinely love to know what you think!
closing:
And if you get stuck, have a question, think something could be better, or just want to tell me what you think - reply to this email, I'll see it and be happy to help.

Thanks again for being here early. It really does mean a lot to us.
Cece
QuoteCore+
